ec0A_barrel_roast:
Barrel with the yak roast in Edward Castle (scene $0A, scene_actors row 13 at tile (28,3B)).

Flag $46 set at spawn: the script jumps into code_04D0FF, which sets $46 again, sets displayModeFlags bit $80, plays MusicAndText #17 ('You've found a large, yummy roast leg of yak!' and Kara's 'Everything's ready!') and dies; as written the pickup message therefore replays whenever the scene loads with $46 set (not watched in the emulator).

$46 clear: waits for scratch $01 (set by the Kara-door guard's talk before the throne scene and by Kara's talk after it, so the barrel is not gated on $21), then installs the talk handler: GiveItem #0A (inventory full: InventoryFullMessage and the flag stays clear), then the code_04D0FF path. A tile trigger at (22,37)-(26,3D) prints Kara's hint 'I think someone put food in one of these barrels.' The escape in ec0A_kara tests the item (BranchIfHasItem #0A), not $46.
ec0A_bed_maid:
Castle maid NPC near the bedroom.

Single dialog about a hunter being hired by the King.
ec0A_caring_maid:
Castle maid NPC with shy guard subplot.

Dialog about someone thinking of her. References the shy guard NPC.
ec0A_door_guard:
Castle entrance guard who escorts Will to King Edward.

Greets Will and directs him to the throne room.
ec0A_edward:
King Edward -- the throne room audience scene (scene $0A).

Spawns solid at his throne (nudged +8 in X). Talk: 'You're Will? You look so...shabby. Well, did you bring the Crystal Ring?' with two answers; they print different lines ('How dare you say such a thing to me!!' for the first, 'Good. An honest lad. Give me the Ring.' ... 'Are you lying to me, young whelp?!' for the second) and both end with 'Guards!! Throw this impudent weasel in prison!!' and set scratch $05. The main script waits on $05, locks the joypad ($CFFC), sets scratch $0A and prints 'Soldier: Yes, sir!'; the throne guards start on $0A and release the lock at the end of the sequence.

Edward sets only scene scratch flags. The persistent flag of this scene, $21, is set by the fade-out helper of ec0A_throne_guard2 just before the prison scene is queued.
ec0A_edwina:
Queen Edwina NPC in the castle.

Brief dialog directing Will to speak with King Edward.
ec0A_kara:
Kara in her room at Edward Castle (scene $0A, scene_actors row 10).

Tests at spawn, in order: $22 set (Kara escaped): dies. $21 set: escort mode (below). $19 set: idles with the plea talk. $1A set: stands at tile (0B,0C) and runs the meeting when Will is near. None set: waits for scratch $01 (the door guard's talk), sets $1A, prints 'Who is it?' / 'A guest?', sets scratch $02 for the guard and falls into the meeting.

Meeting (before the throne scene): locks the joypad ($CFFC); Will says he was told to bring the Crystal Ring; Kara's plea; sets scratch $03 (the guard says 'Princess, let's go'), waits for the guard to clear it, prints 'I feel scared ... Please save me! Take me out of here!', sets $19 and unlocks.

Escort (after the throne scene, $21 set): stands solid at tile (05,0A); her talk ('Of course, you've come! ... His name is Hamlet') sets scratch $01, after which she follows Will (EscortFollowPathTracker). The cellar helper code_04CF5C watches tiles (1E,2C)-(22,2D) for the action button: scratch $01 clear: 'If you want to take her away, now's the time...'; no yak roast (item #0A): 'we should take food! Would you go to the cellar with me?'; with the roast: sets $22 and word $0119, prints 'At last, we leave.', writes $0D60 and $0D62, stages a world-map move and queues scene $06 (Will's house).
ec0A_kara_guard:
Guard outside Kara's room at Edward Castle (scene $0A).

States keyed on flags $21, $19 and $1A:
- $21, $19 and $1A clear: blocks the door with three solid marks. His talk ('This is the Princess's room. Strangers can't enter.') sets scratch $01 and locks the joypad ($CFFC); Kara answers (sets $1A and scratch $02), and the guard prints the 'shabby boy ... Let him in, or I'll tell everyone your old nickname' dialog and unlocks. The script then falls through to the door post (code_04C991).
- At the post: waits for scratch $03 (Kara finished her plea), says 'Princess, let's go.', clears $03 and waits for $19.
- $19 set (Kara's scene is done): talk 'Your business is finished. Get out! Now!' with playerSpeedEw = 8 and bit $0100 ORed into joypadCurrent (a forced walk).
- $21 set (after the throne scene): asleep ('Zzzzz...').

Comedy scene: Kara blackmails him with his old nickname.
ec0A_left_guard:
Left guard at the castle entrance (scene $0A).

Three states, chosen at spawn by flag $21 (the throne scene is over) and flag $3F (the letter was shown):
- $21 and $3F clear (first arrival): sets the joypad lock ($CFFC in joypadMaskStd), runs one walking loop, prints the intrusion dialog and the 'Will shows the letter to the guard' / 'you may pass' lines, sets $3F and releases the lock. The actor never checks for a letter item; the dialog is fixed, so the lock lasts only until this cutscene ends.
- $3F set, $21 clear: patrols between two walking loops for good; talk: 'Go to the second floor if you want to meet King Edward.'
- $21 set (after the throne scene): parked solid at tile (06,27); talk: 'Ah! It's you! You've escaped from the prison... Run from this castle.'
ec0A_null_actor:
Null placeholder actor in Edward Castle.

Empty actor-def with immediate RTL.
ec0A_prison_guard:
Guard blocking the prison entrance in the castle (scene $0A).

$21 clear: solid two tiles high; talk: 'This is the underground prison. Innocent people can't enter.' $21 set (after the throne scene): the actor dies at spawn.
ec0A_right_guard:
Right guard at the castle entrance (scene $0A).

$21 clear: walks one patrol loop (talk meanwhile: 'Be courteous and know that the King is very strict.'), then stands still with a second talk handler. Its first talk prints 'Don't raise your voice. And mind your manners.', gives one Red Jewel (GiveItem #01; inventory full jumps to hidden_red_jewel.HiddenRedJewelInventoryFull and leaves the latch clear), prints 'In exchange, I will give you one Red Jewel.' and sets flag $D8; later talks print only the manners line.

$21 set (after the throne scene): parked at tile (38,29) with the 'Zzzzzz' handler.
ec0A_shy_guard:
Shy guard NPC in Edward Castle.

Humorous single dialog where the guard stammers a love confession.
Part of the caring maid subplot.
ec0A_stair_guard:
Stairway guard NPC in Edward Castle (scene $0A).

$21 clear: solid, blocking the stairs. Talk: 'King Edward is having breakfast. Wait a while, then enter.' The wait is on flag $19 (Will has met Kara; set by ec0A_kara), not on time: once $19 is set the guard clears his solid mark, steps aside, becomes solid again beside the stairs and says 'The interview room is before you. Climb the stairs to meet the king.'

$21 set (after the throne scene): asleep ('Zzzzzz...').
ec0A_stair_maid:
Stairway maid NPC in Edward Castle.

Two-state dialog: initially warns Will about the King, later
asks Will to take care of Kara during the escape.
ec0A_throne_guards:
Throne room guards and the arrest sequence (scene $0A): ec0A_throne_guard1 and ec0A_throne_guard2 (scene_actors rows 09 and 0A).

Both stand solid with the 'keep your wits about you' handler until scratch $0A (set by ec0A_edward) arrives, then walk their routes. Guard2 prints 'Will: Ma'am! Save me!! / Queen Edwina: Did you say Ma'am??' and sets scratch $0B; ec0A_edwina answers with $0C; both guards then continue.

Guard2 then spawns code_04C6F2 (moves Will's X up to $01F8, then #50 steps in Y) and code_04C721, a fade-out (INIDISP brightness 15 down to 0), which SETS flag $21, queues scene $0B (the prison) at ($00E8,$00A0), releases the joypad lock and dies.
ec0A_torch1:
Animated wall torch in Edward Castle (instance 1, ten placements in scene $0A).

The torch exists only after the throne scene: with flag $21 CLEAR the actor dies at spawn; with $21 set it runs the flame loop (RNG-phase start, WaitWhileOffscreen, frame #06 animation).
ec0A_torch2:
Animated wall torch in Edward Castle (instance 2, eleven placements in scene $0A).

Same script as ec0A_torch1 with another position nudge: with flag $21 CLEAR the actor dies at spawn, so the torches exist only after the throne scene.
ec0B_ball:
Prison chain ball inspection dialog.

Will examines a ball and chain that held a previous prisoner.
ec0B_cell:
Prison cell master script (scene $0B, scene_actors row 03 at tile (0B,20)).

Flag $24 (cell door opened with the Prison Key) set: the actor dies at spawn. Otherwise it spawns a VRAM helper (code_04DB00: one AdhocVramDma per frame while scratch $00 is clear), marks the door tiles (0E,11) and (0F,11) solid, locks the joypad, plays Will's opening monologue, unlocks and waits for three scratch handshakes in order: $02 (the door tried), $03 (the moss) and $04 (the ball and chain examined).

After #$04B0 ticks a soldier's whisper announces the bread and the bread child (code_04D346) drops in; its talk (Will tastes the bread) sets scratch $01, and after #$0258 ticks the evening scene runs (joypad lock, the flute and Will's father's voice, the hint to look at the left-hand wall). The script then waits for gemCount to become nonzero (the wall gem, collect_handler_gem), prints the flute dialog and spawns the pig child (code_04D310, 'Oink oink'); talking to the pig gives the Prison Key (item #02) and sets flag $23, which ends the pig and the cell script. The key is used on the door by UseItem_PrisonKey, which sets $24.
ec0B_door:
Locked prison door interaction.

Will tries the door and finds it locked.
ec0B_guard:
Fellow prisoner in the castle prison (scene $0B, tile (02,14)); the label says 'guard' but the dialog ('I don't need anyone's help... I can get out by myself...') is a prisoner's.

At spawn it replays the unlocked-door state of the Prison Key doors: flag $42 set: ClearTypeAbs (09,17); flag $43 set: ClearTypeAbs (14,17) (no code sets $43). Then it marks itself solid, installs the talk handler and writes the player's attribute word ($0E) every frame: $3000 while Will is inside tiles (0D,12)-(11,14), $2000 elsewhere.
ec0B_moss:
Prison wall moss inspection dialog.

Will examines moss growing on the prison wall and reflects on
the prisoners who came before him.
ec0C_force_hint:
Will's hint about enemy-clear jewels (scene $0C, aqueduct entrance).

Dies at spawn when playerMaxHp is not 8. With max HP 8 it yields every frame and, the moment playerMaxHp changes, locks the joypad ($CFFC), waits #$27 ticks, prints 'When you defeat all of the enemies around you, a Jewel will appear.' and unlocks. It reads and writes no event flag.
ec10_dp_hint_spirit:
Dark Space hint spirit in the aqueduct treasure room.

Tutorial dialog explaining dark gems and the extra life mechanic
(collect 100 gems for one life).
it15_bill:
Grandpa Bill NPC in Itory Village (scene $15), solid.

The default talk handler (code_04EFA4) prints 'Meet with the Elder. He knows something.' With flag $47 set at spawn the handler is code_04EFA9, which asks whether Will found a shiny silver stone when he fought the demon at Edward Castle (100 of them give a revive). With $47 clear and $3B clear he waits with WaitOnFlagByte(#3B, #01), shows frame #2C, waits for scratch flag $05 and returns to frame #2A.
it15_elder:
The Elder of Itory Village (scene $15), story NPC.

With flag $41 clear he waits for the player in tiles (04,1C)-(07,1E), prints 'Strange Voice: You've come, Will...', sets $41, then waits for tiles (08,19)-(0D,1A) and prints 'Elder: I'm here. In the flowers.'; with $41 set at spawn he skips both triggers. Then he gets the talk handler code_04E97A and the solid sprite helper code_04E96A.

The handler tests in this order: flag $44 set repeats the legend dialog with its Yes/No loop; item #04 held prints 'It's said that the Moon Tribe has one more. Have Lilly guide you there.'; item #03 held prints the Incan Statue legend and asks 'Understand?' (Yes prints the Moon Tribe line and sets $44; No or cancel repeats the legend); flag $47 set repeats the entrust dialog; scratch $0E set asks 'Do you plan to go?'; scratch $0F set asks 'Were you summoned by your father?'. Otherwise he prints the long family dialog (the barrier, Shira, Bill and Lola) and asks 'Were you summoned by your father?'. Yes prints 'That fulfills Lola's prophesy.' and asks 'Do you plan to go?': Yes prints the entrust dialog for the Incan Statue and sets $47; No or cancel prints 'A disobedient son, unlike your father.' and sets scratch $0E. A No or cancel to the first question prints 'What? If you weren't....That's a bad sign....' and sets scratch $0F. Scratch flags are zeroed at every scene load.
it15_fable_man:
Itory Village NPC who tells an ancient legend.

Dialog about a messenger appearing when the ancient world
was about to be destroyed.
it15_fable_woman:
Itory Village NPC continuing the ancient legend.

Dialog about disease and famine increasing across the world.
it15_friendly_woman:
Itory Village NPC about Lily's loneliness.

Dialog asking Will to befriend Lily since there are no other
children her age in the village.
it15_kara:
Kara in Itory Village -- arrival and departure scenes.

Multi-state dialog: arrives complaining about sore feet,
later decides to accompany Will, then says goodbye.
it15_lily:
Lily in Itory Village -- guide and tutorial NPC.

Major multi-phase actor: introduces the village, teaches the
barrier melody, explains the village's invisible protection,
and guides Will to meet the Elder. Key tutorial sequence.
it15_lola:
Grandma Lola NPC in Itory Village.

Multi-phase dialog: reunites with Will after the kidnapping,
explains how she escaped (poisoned pie), and thanks Lily.
Comic relief scene.
it15_running_man:
Itory Village NPC who hints about the slope dash.

Tutorial dialog suggesting Will run down the hill for a surprise.
it16_song_woman:
NPC in the Itory legend house who explains Incan oral tradition.

Dialog about the Incas preserving their legends in song
rather than writing.
it17_kara:
Kara in Lily's house.

Multi-state dialog: comments on the village breeze, then
insists on joining Will to see the Moon Tribe.
it17_lily:
Lily in her house -- quest direction NPC.

Multi-state dialog covering: directing Will to the Elder,
explaining the Inca Statue location in the cave,
and revealing the Moon Tribe's mountain location.
it18_warning_man:
NPC in Itory couple's house warning about the Incan ruins.

Dialog about gold hunters who entered the ruins and never returned.
it18_warning_woman:
NPC in Itory couple's house commenting on the ruins.

Dialog about leaving the ancient tomb alone.
it19_breakable_wall:
Breakable wall in the Itory cave.

Destructible wall that reveals a passage when attacked.
Guards access to the Incan Statue A collectible.
it19_inca_statue_a:
Incan Statue A collectible in the Itory cave.

Key item pickup with inventory-full fallback dialog.
Required for the Incan Ruins dungeon entrance.
it1A_lily:
Lily at the Moon Tribe camp.

Accompanies Will to the Moon Tribe, waits outside during
the encounter, and reacts to outcomes. Multi-phase dialog
with movement sequences.
it1B_inca_statue_b:
Incan Statue B collectible in the Moon Tribe cave.

Key item pickup with inventory-full fallback dialog.
Second of the two statues needed for the Incan Ruins.
it1B_trial:
Moon Tribe trial in their cave (scene $1B).

With flag word $011C set at spawn the actor dies. Otherwise it locks the joypad ($CFFC), prints the challenge (the creatures touched by the comet's light; destroy them within 20 seconds to get the Incan Statue), unlocks, and runs a decimal countdown from 20 (orbitAngle = $20; orbitDiameter counts #3C ticks per second; sound #10 each second) drawn as digit sprites next to the player. When enemiesRemaining reaches 0 in time it locks the joypad ($FFFC), prints the success dialog, plays sound $0F0F, applies BG change #1C and sets $011C. When the countdown ends first it prints 'In that case, I can't give you the statue.' The trial grants no item itself; the statue is handed out by it1B_inca_statue_b (GiveItem #04).
sc01_astronomer:
South Cape NPC who mentions the approaching star.

No flags. One interact handler prints one dialog ('a star is approaching the Earth'). The actor walks a fixed route in three legs with a wait of $EF ticks before each, then stays at the last stop.
sc01_fisherman:
South Cape fisherman NPC on the south shore, with the strange pot.

At spawn one RNG byte picks the layout: below $C8 he stands at tile (06,2F) and says 'Gosh. I can't pull it up...'; $C8-$EF puts him at tile (0B,33), mirrored, with 'Even if I move to another place I can't pull it up...'; $F0 and above puts him at tile (29,30) beside the pot actor e_sc01_pot ('He lifted the strange teapot.'), unless flag $D7 is set, in which case the second layout is used.

The pot's interact handler gives item $01 (Red Jewel) once, prints 'You've found a Red Jewel!' and sets flag $D7. A full inventory jumps to hidden_red_jewel.HiddenRedJewelInventoryFull before the flag is set.

Every pass the fisherman writes scratch flag $00: set while the player's Y position is $0250 or more, clear otherwise. The player idle-sprite code in player_character reads the same flag. Scratch flags $00-$0F are cleared at every scene load.
sc01_girl1:
South Cape girl playing hide-and-seek.

Counts up to 10 in dialog, then says she lost. Part of the
children-playing ambient scene decoration.
sc01_girl2:
South Cape girl commenting on the hide-and-seek game.

Single dialog about Red Light, Green Light. Part of the children
playing scene.
sc01_girl3:
South Cape girl asking how long they have been playing.

Single dialog line. Part of the children playing scene.
sc01_guard:
South Cape gate guard who blocks town exit before the castle summons.

Three dialog states gated by flags: blocks exit initially (flag $27=0),
allows passage after Edward Castle summons (flag $35), and has a
brief farewell after (flag $27=1). Animates walking to open/close
the gate path.
sc01_house_intro:
South Cape house narration actor.

Each frame the actor tests the player position with BranchIfPlayerAt (exact pixel match): Will's door at X $0208, Y $00E0 or $00DF; Lance's door at ($0128,$0258); Erik's doors at ($0228,$0218) and ($0218,$0178); the cave-exit tile at ($0298,$02C0). The house is chosen by that position; the flags are once-latches.

Will's door: flag $12 clear prints 'This is my house' and sets $12; the door then queues scene $06 at ($0058,$01C0). With $21 set and $26 clear the narration is skipped and the scene change runs directly. Lance's door: $13 latch ('This is Lance's house'). Erik's doors: $14 latch ('My friend Erik lives here'). Cave-exit tile: with $16 set and $17 clear the actor sets $17, locks the joypad ($CFFC), waits $1D ticks, prints 'It was already dark by the time Will left the cave' and unlocks.

The block code_04BCCA repeats Will's door test and has no reference.
sc01_jar_door:
Seth's house door event in South Cape.

Triggers the comedic jar-throwing cutscene when Will approaches
Seth's front door, showing his parents fighting.
sc01_roof_man:
South Cape roof NPC who scolds Will for climbing.

Single dialog about Will's habit of jumping from high places.
Accessible by climbing to the rooftops.
sc01_salesman:
South Cape traveling weapon salesman NPC.

No flags. After a first wait of $EF ticks he walks a fixed route with four stops of $78 ticks each. The interact handler prints 'I won't sell a weapon to a child' (code_0482CD) until the walk ends; the actor then switches the handler to code_0482D2 ('Salesman: Hmmm...') and stands solid.
sc01_seagull:
Animated seagull actor that flies back and forth across South Cape.

Randomly picks a Y height and direction (left or right), then loops
a 3-pass flying animation pattern with sprite movement. Purely
cosmetic ambient decoration.
sc01_smoke:
Null ambient actor for South Cape chimney smoke.

Single actor-def with immediate RTL. Smoke effect is likely handled
by the scene tilemap animation rather than this actor.
sc01_sprint_man:
South Cape NPC who teaches the player about running.

Static NPC with a single dialog explaining the dash mechanic
(press direction twice on the D-pad).
sc01_startled_woman:
South Cape woman who is startled when Will talks to her.

First interaction triggers a surprised reaction. Subsequent
interactions show a different dialog about the sea breeze.
sc01_sympathetic_woman:
South Cape woman who sympathizes with Seth.

Single dialog about feeling sorry for Seth because of his parents
fighting.
sc01_unused_null_npc:
Unused null NPC actor in South Cape (scene $01).

Single actor-def with an immediate RTL — does nothing. Likely a
placeholder that was never removed from the scene data.
sc01_worried_woman:
South Cape woman worried about strange merchants.

No flags. One interact handler prints the worried line. The actor waits $B3 and $77 ticks, then after a delay of $053C ticks walks a route out and back, standing solid for $EF ticks at the far stop, and redraws the metatile at tiles (2C,0E) and (1C,0E) between $F8 and $F9 as she leaves and returns.
sc02_card:
Coastal cave card pickup (the Ace of Diamonds trick).

The scene places one card at tile (07,0A); it runs the entry code_04AFB5 (sprite priority $30, a nudge of (8,0), then idles). Lance spawns four more cards at code_04AFBF (SpawnAfterOffsetFlags in sc02_lance). Each of those stages sprite and hitbox $38 and tests every frame whether the player's position (plus 8 in X and $0A in Y) is within 8 pixels of the card in both axes and the button mask $8001 is pressed. Pressing it prints 'Will picks up a card. It is the Ace of Diamonds, of course!', sets scratch flag $08, locks the joypad ($CFFC) and kills the card; sc02_lance releases the lock. A card out of reach switches to an idle entry once $08 is set. No item is given.
sc02_entry:
Coastal cave entry narration and Lance's gate dialog.

Displays introductory narration about the four friends' hangout.
Lance has a flag-gated dialog asking Will to stay and play.
sc02_erik:
Erik in the coastal cave -- Kara escape news cutscene.

Triggers the major early-game cutscene where Erik rushes in with
news about Princess Kara's escape from Edward Castle. Multi-character
dialog sequence with Lance and Seth reacting.
sc02_lance:
Lance in the coastal cave -- card game and statue chain.

At spawn flag $4C set kills the actor; flag $20 or $16 set selects an idle state with the interact handlers code_04B1A0 ($25 set: 'You look so gloomy'; $1C set: 'It's a day off from school'; otherwise 'One more game with Seth and I'm going home').

Otherwise the first talk sets scratch $01 and prints 'What is it, Will? ... Wait a minute.' After Erik's news (scratch $03 set and cleared) Lance waits for scratch $05 (Seth's 'Everyone's here'; Lance then hints 'Draw it to you by spinning the Flute around like a baton'), scratch $06 (the statue moved) and scratch $07 (Will talks to Lance again). Then he locks the joypad ($CFFC), spawns four sc02_card actors, prints 'Pick the one you think is the Ace of Diamonds', unlocks and waits for scratch $08 (a card picked), prints 'Ahhh! Right!!', waits for scratch $0A (Seth's explanation), prints two lines, sets scratch $0B, clears scratch $04 (which frees the cave exit) and releases the joypad lock.
sc02_seth:
Seth in the coastal cave -- card game and statue puzzle.

Multi-state dialog covering the card game with Lance, reactions
to Kara's escape news, and the cave statue puzzle sequence.
sc03_lances_mother:
Lance's frail mother NPC.

Multi-state dialog gated by story progression. Initially speaks
about Will's father being lost at the Tower of Babel. Dialog
changes as the story progresses.
sc04_eriks_father:
Erik's father NPC in his house.

Single dialog about the big house and being early settlers.
sc04_eriks_mother:
Erik's mother NPC with a humorous treatment dialog.

Explains she is using a heat treatment for sore muscles.
Complains about cleaning the big house.
sc04_poverty:
Erik's house NPC (neighbor/visitor) with a philosophy dialog.

Comments about how small things make you rich or poor.
sc05_seths_father:
Seth's father NPC -- one side of the arguing parents.

Dialog about spending money. Part of the fighting-parents theme
that drives Seth's character.
sc05_seths_mother:
Seth's mother NPC -- the other side of the arguing parents.

Dialog about putting up with Seth's father for Seth's sake.
Part of the family conflict theme.
sc06_bill:
Grandpa Bill NPC in Will's house -- multi-phase story actor.

Complex flag-gated dialog covering: initial homecoming, Lola's
opera singing, the soldier/Kara arrest event, the kidnapping,
and post-rescue states. One of the most story-critical NPCs
in Will's house with screen fade and music change sequences.
sc06_hamlet:
Hamlet the pig -- Kara's pet in Will's house.

Ambient pig actor that oinks and wrecks the room. Appears after
Kara arrives. Will comments on the pig in his house.
sc06_kara:
Kara's first meeting with Will in his house.

Runs the full introduction cutscene: Kara comments on Will's
house, asks about his parents, and they look at the family
photo together. Multi-character dialog with movement sequences.
sc06_kara_return:
Kara's return to Will's house -- kidnapping aftermath.

Major story cutscene: Kara returns to find Will's grandparents
missing, the house ransacked. Multi-phase sequence with Lily's
arrival, the journey to Itory Village, and Kara's departure.
Sets multiple story flags.
sc06_lily:
Lily's appearance in Will's house after the kidnapping.

Introduces Lily and Itory Village. Dialog sequence where Lily
offers to help, Kara insists on coming, and they depart.
Sets the Itory Village storyline in motion.
sc06_lola:
Grandma Lola NPC in Will's house.

Multi-state dialog: initially cooking dinner, later singing
opera with Bill, and post-kidnapping states. Key domestic
NPC with several story-gated dialog branches.
sc06_main_soldier:
Edward Castle soldier who arrests Kara in Will's house.

Cutscene actor. At spawn flag $1B set kills it; otherwise it waits for scratch flag $04 (Lola's line), takes tile (0A,19) and watches for the player inside tiles (04,19)-(0E,1D). On entry it locks the joypad ($CFFC), waits $1D ticks, steps in, prints the soldier and Kara exchange, sets scratch $07 and waits for scratch $08 (Kara's reply), then walks off and dies. It sets no persistent flag: sc06_kara sets $1B, and sc06_bill releases the joypad lock.
sc06_monologue:
Will's end-of-day narration in his house.

Displays the dinner scene narration (snail pie feast) and the
transition to the next morning. Bridges the Kara meeting day
to the kidnapping event.
sc06_wills_pet:
Will's pet animal in his house.

Small ambient actor. Minimal dialog.
sc07_chef:
Chef's house NPC in South Cape.

Single dialog about cooking in a pot since there is no stove.
sc08_erik:
Erik in the South Cape school after the opening lesson.

Speaks his lines about going home first and heading to the cave.
Part of the post-school cutscene sequence.
sc08_lance:
Lance in the South Cape school after the opening lesson.

Speaks about meeting at the usual place (the seaside cave).
Part of the post-school cutscene sequence.
sc08_priest:
South Cape school teacher (Priest) who gives the opening narration.

At spawn the actor stands solid with the interact handler code_048AD9 (flag $21 clear: 'Please recite with me'; set: 'What is it, Will?'). With flag $10 clear it locks the joypad ($CFFC), waits $1D ticks, prints Will's monologue, waits $3B ticks, plays six sound pairs $1E ticks apart, prints the lesson ('That's all for today's lesson'), waits $3B ticks and sets $10. That is the only flag it sets; sc08_erik releases the joypad lock after its walk. With $10 set at load the lesson is skipped and the joypad stays free; Lance, Erik and Seth die at spawn.
